Data Definition Language The schema for each relation. The type of values associated with each attribute. The Integrity constraints The set of indices to be maintained for each relation. Security and authorization information for each relation. The physical storage structure of each relation on disk.The SQL data- definition language (DDL) allows the specification of information about relations, including:
